title: RSafe: Incentivizing proactive reasoning to build robust and adaptive LLM safeguards
reasoning: The paper develops and evaluates an LLM safeguard system against multiple safety and ethical benchmarks. Specifically, it includes an evaluation of the model's adaptivity to medical ethics principles using the MedSafetyBench and CARES benchmarks, and its safety taxonomy includes categories such as 'Hate Speech & Discrimination'.
